command:
set -euo pipefail
echo BRIDGE_CONTAINER_OK
python3 --version
git --version
curl --version | head -n1
mkdir -p /cache/bridge-selftest
webfetch https://raw.githubusercontent.com/git/git/master/README.md /cache/bridge-selftest/git-readme.md
test -s /cache/bridge-selftest/git-readme.md
python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib, json, os, pathlib, platform
p=pathlib.Path('/cache/bridge-selftest/git-readme.md')
out={
 'schema':'CLAY_VPS_BRIDGE_SELFTEST/v1',
 'pass':True,
 'python':platform.python_version(),
 'kernel':platform.release(),
 'cpu_count':os.cpu_count(),
 'download_path':str(p),
 'download_sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
 'download_bytes':p.stat().st_size,
 'workspace':os.getcwd(),
}
print(json.dumps(out,sort_keys=True))
PY
echo BRIDGE_SELFTEST_PASS
